title: GoPTX: Fine-grained GPU Kernel Fusion by PTX-level Instruction Flow Weaving
problem: Concurrent kernel execution on GPUs misses opportunities to mitigate warp stalls and improve instruction-level parallelism (ILP) through inter-kernel resource sharing due to sequential default execution of kernels.
motivation: GPU kernel fusion can boost efficiency, but existing approaches overlook ILP improvements from deliberate instruction-level coordination across fused kernels.
method: GoPTX performs fine-grained kernel fusion at the PTX (Parallel Thread Execution) instruction level by establishing a merged control flow graph, interleaving instructions from multiple kernels to minimize pipeline stalls on data hazards; proposes latency-aware instruction weaving algorithm and adaptive code slicing to enlarge scheduling space.
key_novelty: PTX-level instruction flow weaving enabling fine-grained interleaving across kernel boundaries to improve ILP while minimizing stalls.
contributions: PTX-level kernel fusion approach with merged CFG
Instruction interleaving algorithm minimizing data hazard stalls
Latency-aware weaving algorithm for efficient instruction scheduling
Adaptive code slicing method enlarging scheduling space
Average 11.2% speedup over concurrent execution, max 23%

metrics.resource_utilization: enhanced eligible warps per cycle and resource use

limitations: Not discussed; focus is on PTX-level optimization.
primary_theme: PTX-level kernel fusion via instruction flow weaving for ILP improvement
